subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, consent, and subscription contract should it expose?
rationale: Source review proves the missing capability, but receiving non-mentioned Space content changes data visibility, credential storage, OAuth scopes, and operator consent boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub design with SecretRef-aware credentials, explicit scopes, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep Mentioned Webhooks Only
options.body: Leave the official plugin on the current service-account webhook model and handle only separate thread-reply/session cleanup.

options.title: Defer To Shared Workspace Auth
options.body: Wait for a broader Google Workspace token, consent, event-subscription, and admin-approval model before accepting this channel-specific expansion.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub design with SecretRef-aware credentials, explicit scopes, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from merged thread work, prior review context, and Google Chat plugin history.
